On Wed, Mar 25, 2026 at 08:15 AM laura.bennett@redwood.com wrote:
> Team — attaching the compiled evidence bundle and the scoring rubric for Q1. ...

Laura / Vivek — I reviewed the Clarion thread in the evidence bundle and I disagree with the 5/10 for Objective 2. The renewal slip was driven primarily by a product expectation mismatch (Clarion expected GPU-backed private deployment in-region) and a delayed procurement signature — not by adoption failure. The Clarion CS notes (see customer_feedback_clarion.pdf) show continued usage of hosted endpoints and a positive CSAT for the pilot.

Proposed change: Objective 2 -> 6/10 (adjust to reflect product/contract timing rather than adoption signal). Rationale: pipeline health metric (active seats) is stable; churn risk remains low but timing shifts hurt our Q1 realization. I flagged specific messages in the Clarion packet (pages 3–5) where procurement timeline is called out.

Also: we should capture a short decision log entry that this score change is conditional on a 30-day procurement follow-up. If procurement remains open beyond 30 days, we revert to 4/10 and trigger renewal playbook.

If nobody objects by EOD Thu I will accept the 6/10 and update the evidence bundle notes.

—Monica
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Forwarding my quick calc and rubric pointer. Monica — I agree with your framing that this is a timing/procurement issue not an engagement failure. Per the rubric (sheet 'RevenueSignals' in okr_rubric.xlsx):
- If customer continues transaction activity and CSAT >= 7/10, performance is in the 'partial met' bucket (6/10).
- If procurement is the only blocker and we have active usage, we discount by one point vs target.

Quick math (attached spreadsheet tab 'Clarion_calc'): baseline ARR realization target = $450k; recognized in Q1 = $90k (pilot). That puts pace at ~20% of expectation; with confirmed PO timeline within 30 days we consider it recoverable (6/10). If PO slips beyond 30 days or CS notes show usage decline, downgrade to 4/10.

I've attached okr_rubric.xlsx with my comments in the 'Clarion_calc' tab — will upload updated numbers to the Drive link once final score decided. Agree with Mon's conditional decision log language.
